profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Corporate Travel Management US
profile.summary:
HIGHLIGHTS: 
 • Backend development.
 • API design/development (Laravel, .net).
 • Azure devops (pipelines).
 • PHP, Python, C#.
 • Full stack development.
 • Relational Database Design (PostgreSQL, MySql).
 • Linux administration & DevOps.
 • Search engine (Elasticsearch/Solr).
 • Shell Scripting.
 • Docker.
 • Kubernetes, helm.
 • CI.
 • FrontEnd Development (HTML, CSS, Javascript, VueJS).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and leading api architecture and development.
• Code reviews to ensure the code consistency.
• Designed database architecture.
• Developed new features in current applications.
• Created Jenkins jobs.
• Migrated to azure devops pipelines.
• Developed scripts and devops to automate tasks.
• Keep and improve the utilization of Docker, kubernetes, helm to improve the development process.
• Developed unit tests and integration tests.

Achievements:
• Implemented automation process and continuous integration Gitlab/Jenkins.
• Implemented the enforcement of code standardization in development process.
• Implemented deployment process (azure devops, kubernetes).
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · .NET Framework · DevOps · CI · Shell Scripting · laravel MVC

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Improved and maintained legacy web applications using homebrewed PHP framework.
 • Maintain and designed database architecture (PostgreSQL).
 • Developed APIs, Websites (Drupal, WP)
 • Created Jenkins jobs to efficiently deliver software updates.
 • Developed scripts and devops to automate tasks.
 • Integrating third party applications with our systems (Tropo SMS, InContact Text to Chat, Rapidpro).
 • Create and improve technical documentation (Confluence).

Achievements:
 • Implemented a software development process and continuous integration to make sure all software is delivery on time.
 • Architected a RESTful API that enabled access to a database of over 35,000 services in Los Angeles County and beyond.
 • Proposed and implemented an Elasticsearch index to cut the time that people can find vital services to 1/3rd. The data indexing time was reduced  by 95%.
 • Integrated API as a micro service into all applications in the organization.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed custom websites with PHP, html, joomla, wordpress . 
 • Built eCommerce Websites (opencart, prestashop, magento).
 • Built responsive websites.
 • Web Server configuration and Administration.
 • SEO.

Achievements:
 • Saved clients that were unhappy with previous uncompleted projects.
 • Implemented a development process (saving time and frustration).

positions.title: Linux Cluster Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed LAMP applications.
 • Developed frontend and backend web based applications.
 • Installed, Configured and administration of  Rhels, Sles, ubuntu server at cluster level.
 • Shell scripting.
 • Configured infiniband, ethernet switches networking.
 • Configured storage (DS3000, DS4000) and IBM xSeries servers.
 • Updated firmware levels on devices and server.
 • Implemented test process documentation.
 • Executed hardware and software debugging.
 • High complex cluster testing. 
 • xCat Administration.

Achievements:
 • Developed a manufacturing floor system that reduced data collection time by 40%.
 • Implemented disk-less firmware update, reducing time process 50%.

positions.title: Manufacturing Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed LAMP applications.
 • Developed frontend and backend web based applications.
 • Developed manufacturing Routes for SUN Microsystems (V20Z, V40Z servers) assembly process.
 • Applied engineering changes, ran FOT, made reworks instructions.
 • In charged of package, kitting and progressive assembly area.

Achievements:
 • Developed  web application manufacturing global instructions.
 • Developed  web application for  personal certification.
 • Designed training methodologies and tools for assembly process.
 • Implemented the progressive assembly for V40Z systems, reduced time assembly 15%.
